quote_currency.per_share_note: 1 ADS = 1 Class Z ordinary share (1:1 ratio). All per-share values are USD/ADS. Financials internally in RMB millions; per-share values converted at RMB/USD 7.10. current_price uses the BILI USD Nasdaq price because the DCF is built in USD/ADS.
quote_currency.crosscheck_note: 9626.HK Yahoo Finance live price: HKD 124.70 / 7.78 = USD 16.03 — consistent with BILI live USD 16.14 (delta ~0.7%, within normal bid-ask/FX spread). Both prices confirmed live from Yahoo Finance chart endpoint on 2026-06-26.
quote_currency.price_source_bili: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint BILI: USD 16.14 (regularMarketPrice, 2026-06-26)

inputs.shares_note: Diluted ADS-equivalent shares as of Q1 2026 (459.5M per CSV; rounded to 459M); reflects completed US$200M buyback in Q1 2026
inputs.net_cash_note: Net cash of RMB 14.6B (Q1 2026 balance sheet). Cash of RMB 24.19B includes short-term investments; debt of RMB 9.57B includes convertible notes.
inputs.last_fcf_source: FY2025 OCF (RMB 7,147.1M) minus estimated CapEx at 3% of FY2025 revenue (RMB 910.4M). CapEx rate consistent with asset-light platform model.
inputs.valuation_note: FY2025 is Bilibili's first full year of GAAP profitability. FCF-based DCF is used as the primary methodology; the company's recent profitability inflection makes trailing P/E less meaningful. FCF margin expansion trajectory (current 20.6%, targeting 40-45% GP mid-term) is the critical assumption.

historical_growth.eps_3yr_cagr_note: Not calculable — EPS was negative through FY2024; FY2025 is first profitable year (EPS RMB 2.74)
historical_growth.equity_2yr_cagr_note: FY2023 (14,392) to FY2025 (15,573); prior years provide 3yr+ equity data for review
historical_growth.fcf_1yr_growth_note: FY2024 est FCF (5,210M) to FY2025 est FCF (6,237M); FCF only turned positive in FY2023/24
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2025 actual 1yr revenue growth (13.1%), used as the anchor for the base case Year 1. Equity CAGR suppressed by years of losses; FCF only meaningful since FY2024. Revenue growth is the most reliable long-run signal.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Standard CAGR flags (equity vs revenue vs EPS) are not applicable in the usual sense for Bilibili: (1) EPS CAGR is uncalculable from negative base; (2) equity CAGR understates economic progress as the company invested heavily through losses. The 5yr revenue CAGR of 20.5% is anchored to high-growth early years; the recent 3yr CAGR of 11.3% and 1yr growth of 13.1% are more forward-representative. Base case growth of 15% in Year 1 slightly exceeds recent actuals, justified by advertising acceleration (+30% in Q1 2026) and gaming recovery.

base.scenario_description: Moderate growth with ongoing FCF margin expansion toward mid-term management targets. Advertising sustains high-teens growth, gaming recovers in H2 2026 from new title launches. Company reaches ~33% FCF margin by Year 5 (gross margin ~40-42%, operating margin ~12-15%).
base.revenue_growth_rationale: Y1 15%: advertising +30% partially offset by gaming trough; Y2-3 13-11% as gaming recovers and advertising normalizes; Y4-5 9-7% mature deceleration toward terminal.
base.fcf_margin_rationale: Starting above FY2025 actual 20.6% as FY2025 included elevated AI CapEx ramp. Expansion toward 33% by Y5 consistent with 40-45% GP target and 15-30% adj operating margin guidance, applied to FCF conversion.
base.wacc_rationale: Risk-free rate ~2.5% (China 10Y gov bond); equity risk premium 9% (Chinese tech with VIE structure, regulatory risk, US-China geopolitical premium); beta 1.2; blended WACC ~11.5%.
base.terminal_growth_rationale: China nominal GDP growth ~4.5-5%; Bilibili as mature Gen Z platform grows at modest discount to GDP given community defensibility offset by market saturation. 3.5% is within long-term digital economy growth estimates.

bull.scenario_description: Strong execution: advertising continues 25%+ growth on AI tailwinds, Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Wangdaotianxia launches successfully in Q4 2026 (Morgan Stanley projects 1.7B RMB annualized), FCF margin reaches upper management guidance. Regulatory environment remains stable. US$300M buyback signals management confidence.
bull.revenue_growth_rationale: Y1 20%: advertising acceleration + gaming recovery more rapid than expected; Y2 17% from gaming upcycle peak (2027 consensus ~6.8-7.8B RMB gaming revenue); gradual deceleration thereafter.
bull.fcf_margin_rationale: Faster path to upper-end management margin targets (45% GP, 30% adj operating); advertising is the highest-margin segment at scale.
bull.wacc_rationale: Lower risk premium as profitability track record extends (FY2025 GAAP profit, Q1 2026 continuation); Chinese tech sentiment improvement; reduced HFCAA delisting risk after dual-listing solidification.
bull.terminal_growth_rationale: Sustained Gen Z leadership allows growth at or slightly above China nominal GDP; expansion into adjacent categories (AI, e-commerce adjacencies) supports premium.

bear.scenario_description: Gaming disappointment: Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Wangdaotianxia delayed or underperforms; advertising growth reverts toward market rates as AI-sector ad budgets normalize; macro headwinds from China consumer weakness and US-China tensions; competition from Douyin/Tencent intensifies. Profitability at risk of reversal in weaker quarters.
bear.revenue_growth_rationale: Y1 8%: gaming continues declining, advertising growth normalizes to market rate; Y2-4 gradual deceleration as competitive pressure mounts; Y5 3% near-GDP in a stagnant user base.
bear.fcf_margin_rationale: Margins hover near FY2025 actual as investment pressure (AI CapEx, content investment to compete) prevents meaningful expansion. FCF margin limited to 24% even in Y5.
bear.wacc_rationale: Elevated risk premium: renewed HFCAA enforcement pressure, regulatory crackdown risk, gaming license uncertainty, competitive threats from companies with 5-10x the resources. Sustained loss-of-confidence risk premium.
bear.terminal_growth_rationale: User base mature, MAU growth plateaued at ~376M; monetization ceiling without gaming or advertising scale-up; growth below China GDP as niche platform faces structural limits.

base.rationale: To achieve 15% CAGR to terminal value, entry at $33.25. Current price of $16.14 is 106% below this entry hurdle, implying significant margin of safety even under base case assumptions.

bull.rationale: Bull case entry price of $56.97 for 15% CAGR; current price is 253% below this, implying potential for well above 15% CAGR from current levels.

bear.rationale: Bear case entry price for 15% CAGR is $13.97 — current price of $16.14 is 15.5% above this hurdle. Bear case offers modest upside (75%) but not a 15% CAGR to terminal. This provides important downside framing.

sensitivity.description: Intrinsic Value per ADS (USD) — Base Case Revenue Growth & FCF Margins
sensitivity.notes: Every cell in the sensitivity matrix is above the current price of $16.14. Current price implies either below-bear-case or a near-zero terminal value assignment. WACC 11.5% / TGR 3.5% is the base case (row 3, col 3 = $57.08). Minimum matrix value ($43.10) is 2.67x current price.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25 weighting reflects genuine uncertainty: strong execution evidence (15 consecutive quarters of GM expansion, FY2025 GAAP profit) supports avoiding a bear-heavy tilt, but gaming revenue trough, regulatory overhang, and China macro headwinds are real. Bear weight of 25% reflects HFCAA revival risk and gaming uncertainty.

peer_comparison.context: Bilibili trades at 1.25x EV/Revenue — a discount to slower-growing Kuaishou (1.5-2.0x) despite superior FCF growth momentum. The market is pricing near-zero terminal FCF value, which is inconsistent with a platform generating RMB 7.15B OCF on RMB 30.3B revenue and holding RMB 14.6B net cash.

sanity_flags.detail: Terminal value represents 73.8% of base case enterprise value. This is within normal range for a growth-stage internet platform transitioning to maturity (typically 65-80%), but means the valuation is highly sensitive to WACC and terminal growth rate assumptions.

Base case IV implies 4.9x EV/FY2026E Revenue — at the upper range for Chinese internet peers (Kuaishou 1.5-2.0x, iQiyi 0.8-1.2x). However, Bilibili's superior growth (13% vs peers at 6-10%) and profitability trajectory justify a 2-3x premium to loss-making or slower peers. The 4.9x implied multiple assumes successful margin execution. Bear case (2.4x EV/Rev) is well within peer range.
sanity_flags.note: No auto-fix applied. The FCF margin trajectory (25-33%) is grounded in management guidance for 40-45% gross margin. A stress test capping FCF margins at 22% through Year 5 yields $40.54 USD/ADS — still 151% above current price of $16.14.

sanity_flags.detail: Trailing GAAP P/E of 44x is high in isolation, but FY2025 was Bilibili's first profitable year with a net margin of only 3.9%. Forward adjusted P/E of 22.5x (Q1 2026 annualized) is more representative; PEG of 1.50x is reasonable for a platform with 15% growth potential. EV/Revenue (1.25x current) and EV/FCF (6.1x) are the more appropriate near-term metrics.

Even the bear case DCF (WACC 13%, terminal growth 2.5%, FCF margins capped at 24%) yields $28.18 per ADS vs. current $16.14 — a 75% upside. This implies the current market price is more pessimistic than even the bear case DCF scenario. The spread suggests the market is pricing in structural risks beyond standard fundamental analysis (regulatory/delisting/VIE optionality discount).

stress_test.description: FCF margins capped at 20-22% (no expansion vs FY2025 baseline), base revenue growth rates
stress_test.conclusion: Even under a conservative no-margin-expansion scenario, the DCF implies $40.54 per ADS vs. current $16.14 (151% upside). The current price discount appears structural (regulatory/geopolitical discount, China internet sentiment, loss history) rather than reflective of fair fundamental value.

sanity_check.overall_verdict: Model passes sanity check. Current market price of $16.14 (BILI) / HKD 124.70 (9626.HK) implies EV/Revenue of 1.25x, which appears to assign near-zero terminal FCF value to a growing, newly profitable platform with a RMB 14.6B net cash cushion equal to ~86% of market cap. The implied valuation at current prices would only be fair if Bilibili's revenue growth stalls below 3% and FCF margins never exceed 20% — inconsistent with Q1 2026 actuals. Both the base case ($57.08) and bear case ($28.18) DCF values significantly exceed the current market price. The sensitivity table shows every WACC/TGR combination considered produces an IV above current price (minimum cell $43.10 = 2.67x current price).

valuation_philosophy.primary_methodology: 5-Year Free Cash Flow DCF with Gordon Growth Model terminal value
valuation_philosophy.why_fcf_not_earnings: Bilibili turned GAAP-profitable only in FY2025. Using FCF avoids distortion from non-cash stock compensation (historically 5-8% of revenue) and reflects true cash generation capacity of the platform model. FCF margin expansion is the primary value driver, not near-term reported EPS.
valuation_philosophy.currency_treatment: All projections in RMB (functional currency). Per-ADS values converted at RMB 7.10/USD. The USD/ADS comparison is used because 1 ADS = 1 ordinary share on Nasdaq. current_price is set to the BILI Nasdaq USD price (16.14) for internal consistency; 9626.HK HKD 124.70 is documented as a cross-check (implied USD 16.03 at HKD/USD 7.78, delta 0.7%).
valuation_philosophy.china_discount: A 9% equity risk premium (vs. ~5.5% for US tech) is embedded in the WACC to account for VIE structure, HFCAA/delisting risk, content regulatory uncertainty, and China macro cyclicality. This discount is explicit and deliberate rather than a post-hoc adjustment.
valuation_philosophy.key_assumption_risk: The FCF margin expansion from 20.6% (FY2025) to 25-33% (Y1-Y5 base) is the single most important assumption to monitor. If management's 40-45% gross margin and 15-30% adjusted operating margin targets are delayed by 2+ years, the base IV converges toward the $40 stress test level.

warning_banner.message: Bilibili achieved its first full year of GAAP profitability in FY2025 (net margin 3.9%). This DCF is based on the expectation of continued margin expansion. The company is early in its profitability curve — monitor quarterly gross margin and OCF trends closely.
key_metrics_to_watch: Gross margin quarterly trend (target: sustained above 37%, expanding toward 40%+)
Advertising revenue growth rate (Q1 2026: +30% YoY — watch for deceleration below 15%)
Gaming revenue (in a trough — watch for H2 2026 recovery from new title launches)
Adjusted net profit margin (Q1 2026: 7.8% — should be expanding QoQ)
Operating cash flow (FY2025: RMB 7.15B — should grow 15%+ annually in base case)

analyst_consensus.ratings_note: Morgan Stanley Overweight ($31 PT, April 2026 upgrade); Citi and JPMorgan upgraded in March 2026. 8-analyst consensus 'Strong Buy'.
analyst_consensus.dcf_vs_consensus: DCF base case ($57) is materially above sell-side consensus (~$31), reflecting DCF's 5-year terminal value capture vs. near-term 12-month price targets. The DCF represents intrinsic value over a 5-year horizon.

current_market_context.buyback_impact: US$300M buyback program authorized June 24, 2026. At $16.14/ADS, this equates to ~18.6M shares or ~4.1% of float, providing direct accretive support to per-share value.
current_market_context.new_game_catalyst: Three Kingdoms: Battle for the Realm (SLG) launched July 2, 2026. Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Wangdaotianxia (flagship) expected Q4 2026 — the most important catalyst for gaming revenue recovery.

comparable_companies.note: Chinese internet platforms trade at a structural discount to global peers due to regulatory, VIE, and geopolitical risk. Bilibili's profitability inflection is not yet fully reflected in market multiples.

peers.notes: Larger scale, profitable, but slower growth
US peer; comparable community/interest-graph model; trades at significant premium due to no China discount

key_value_drivers.description: FY2025 FCF margin ~20.6%. Management targets 40-45% gross margin and 15-30% adjusted operating margin. Every 1pp improvement in FCF margin from the FY2025 revenue base adds ~RMB 303M to FCF, worth ~RMB 4B NPV (~$8.5 per ADS at base WACC). This is the #1 value driver.

Advertising grew 30% YoY in Q1 2026, now ~33% of revenue. AI-enhanced targeting (ECPM +10%+ YoY) and AI-sector advertiser spend (+170% YoY) are platform-specific tailwinds. Sustaining 20%+ ad growth for 2-3 years would materially accelerate the base case.

Gaming declined ~12-14% YoY in Q4 2025/Q1 2026 from San Guo: Mou Ding Tian Xia maturation. Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Wangdaotianxia (Q4 2026 expected) is the key catalyst — Morgan Stanley models 7.8B RMB game revenue in 2027 vs. 6.4B in FY2025.

RMB 14.6B net cash (~86% of current market cap) provides massive optionality: buybacks ($300M new program), M&A, gaming investment, AI CapEx, or debt paydown. Net cash creates a floor on valuation and eliminates near-term financial distress risk.
35M paying users from 376M MAU = 9.3% penetration. Increasing to 12-15% penetration (comparable to other video platforms) at stable ARPPU would add RMB 1-2B annually to VAS revenue.

Content regulation, game license approvals, and VIE rules are ongoing risks. Game license environment has been healthy (497 approved Q4 2025, +30% YoY), but regulatory surprises can materially impact the gaming revenue recovery thesis.

valuation_summary.investment_thesis: Bilibili has achieved its first full year of GAAP profitability (FY2025 net profit RMB 1.19B) and continued the trend in Q1 2026 (GAAP profit RMB 202M, adjusted net RMB 585M). The platform's 15 consecutive quarters of gross margin expansion — reaching 37.1% in Q1 2026 — demonstrates structural monetization improvement, not a cyclical blip. At $16.14/ADS, the stock trades at just 1.25x EV/Revenue with a net cash position of RMB 14.6B (~86% of market cap) providing a substantial floor. The DCF base case of $57.08 (254% upside) and even the bear case of $28.18 (75% upside) both significantly exceed the current price, suggesting the market is assigning a near-zero terminal FCF value to a growing, newly profitable platform. Key catalysts: gaming recovery from Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Wangdaotianxia (Q4 2026 launch), continued advertising momentum (+30% YoY in Q1 2026), and US$300M buyback execution. The primary risks are gaming execution failure, advertising growth normalization, and persistent China internet valuation discount.

valuation_summary.hold_criteria: Hold until price approaches $45-55 (base case range with some discount to IV); re-evaluate if FY2026 GAAP profitability reverses or quarterly gross margin expansion stalls for 2+ quarters.
valuation_summary.sell_criteria: Sell if: (1) price exceeds $80 (bull case with limited further upside); (2) Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Wangdaotianxia significantly underperforms expectations; (3) gross margin expansion reverses for 2+ consecutive quarters; (4) MAU declines materially from 376M; (5) major regulatory action threatens the business model or gaming license pipeline.
